review:
A 5x3 with mystical rings, stopwatches and orbs. Diamonds landing on reel one or five collect every cash icon on reels two to four.

Three scatters give 10 free spins with more cash and collectors. Land the watch and padlock together and time freezes: every cash value locks in place and the spin counter stops, giving you respins on a frozen board. A neat bit of tension for a collect game. Up to 4,888x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
